Quotes / Thomas Aquinas / Q0327

English

Prudence is right reason applied to action.
Thinker Thomas Aquinas
School Scholasticism
Source Summa Theologiae II-II, q.47, a.2
Theme Wisdom
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Summa Theologiae II-II, q.47, a.2, within the tradition of Scholasticism. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of wisdom, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Thomas Aquinas's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
